_pose_comment: default_pos_deg below is the static standing-balance pose (NOT the old forward_slow walking gait's keyframe-0) -- found empirically with tune_stance_lean_isaaclab.py against qmini_urdf-2legs.usda's real mass distribution (battery + Pi mount etc.), and what qmini.py's ArticulationCfg.InitialStateCfg.joint_pos / keyframes_standing_still.json's keyframe-0 both currently use for training. Use this config (not robot_config_qmini.json or the _forward_slow/_left_strafe/_left_turn variants) together with --keyframes keyframes_standing_still.json to deploy the standing-balance policy.
_imu_comment: axis_remap is [[chip_axis_index, sign], ...] for base_link's own [X, Y, Z]. Confirmed in Isaac Sim: base_link +X points toward the LEFT leg, +Y toward the REAR, +Z is up. Chip mount: chip X+ = robot rear, chip Y+ = robot right leg, chip Z+ = up. So base_X=-chip_Y, base_Y=chip_X, base_Z=chip_Z. VERIFIED against the real sensor on 2026-09-09 via imu_calibration_check.py -- this remap is confirmed correct on real hardware, not just in sim.
_imu_mount_comment: 2026-10-04: correction available but set to 0. A first estimate of +3.0/-1.0 assumed the robot top is parallel to base_link; it is NOT (top is 2.841 deg tilted back vs base, IMU mount is parallel to base). On the level stand: raw IMU pitch -0.89 / roll +1.04, phone on top 2-3 deg back -> base ~-0.3 +- 0.5 deg, i.e. IMU agrees within ~0.5 deg. Values are degrees ADDED to reported pitch (+ = back) / roll (+ = left).
_stand_pose_comment: 2026-10-12: absolute calibration (see robot_deploy.py RobotConfig.stand_pose_reference). The file holds every joint's raw reading in a carefully placed reference stand pose; record it with --record-stand-pose (robot on its stand, motors limp) and re-record after reassembling any motor/part. Without the file the deploy refuses to start.
_startup_offset_comment: 2026-10-09: startup_offset_deg is added to default_pos_deg ONLY for the rest pose (the --startup-pose default move and the soft-stop ramp), not for the policy's action anchor. Ankles 3 deg forward (left -3 / right +3, same direction as robot_config_qmini_stepinplace_ankle_fwd3.json) so the robot stands on its own before the policy starts and after a soft stop. Training starts episodes with up to +-5 deg ankle noise, so starting the policy from here is in-distribution.
_walk_startup_offset_comment: 2026-10-14: residual walking bundles rest on the gait reference stance (zero command, phase 0) + walk_startup_offset_deg instead of default_pos_deg + startup_offset_deg. Library v3's stance stands on its own in sim only with the ankles 3-6 deg forward (0/-2 tips backward, -4 holds 0 deg pitch, -6.5 tips forward; check_static_pose_stability.py --from-gait-library --ankle-offsets, friction 0.3 and 0.5).
